# Package-visible carrier factory

An original package-visible static factory binds its invariant seed and result
to its own Object-bound formal, independently of its generic owner. Public
same-package clients retain the calls, scalar and fixed contexts, opaque result
and original package access. Source and SDK declarations use the same proof.

Four frozen routes run 112 fresh JVM cases twice per layout. Observers check
input identity, extreme integers, context aliases, partial writes, delayed seed
casts, unchecked result casts and exact checked, runtime and Error failures.
Seventeen wrong programs fail before recovery, including publicizing the
original factory. Eight same-Code Signature controls fail recovery. All emitted
Java compiles; complete original metadata, Code roles, Exceptions, visibility
and helper accounting are retained. Native tests independently reject foreign
package callers, private/protected roles, wrong words and unproved contracts.
